construction_note: Platform level is the shared local zero. The independent post-foot fit returned +0.127 m with the bases partly behind planting and the outer railing. Shafts reach the platform. The outer diameter estimates from photos 4 and 6 span roughly 0.37–0.47 m; the inner roughly 0.52–0.55 m. The side arch is perpendicular to the double-door wall. Its fitted crown is taken directly from garden-cameras.json; the rigid finished shoulders and radiused arch connect at spring height, and the opening continues through the return.
photographic_uncertainties: Two-view free triangulation places the side arch near X=-5.1 m. Looking inward from 6 the west face is estimated near -5.25 m, and from 4 the east reveal near -5.03 m. The rectangular doorway has exposed square jambs and is observed through this arch from 4. Allow about ±0.2 m on wall depth and spring heights. The bright and dark halves in 6 and the visible leaf edges support a partly open right leaf; its 37° opening and the handle depth are conditional rendering estimates.
steps: In 6 the platform descends by two lower treads to the garden paving. Bottom paving lies about 0.42 m below the landing. Both step noses extend beyond the left image boundary; the northwest end on the component uses the west bay envelope. Tread runs estimated from the short visible ends, ±0.10 m.
